in_hebrew.name: Hooker
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Nickname for a fisherman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hooker הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A nickname derived from the Old English word 'hoc,' meaning 'hook.' The name became associated with fishermen due to their use of hooks to catch fish.

in_greek.name: Hooker

in_greek.long_meaning: Hooker είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. A nickname derived from the Old English word 'hoc,' meaning 'hook.' The name became associated with fishermen due to their use of hooks to catch fish.

in_latin.name: Hooker
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Nickname for a fisherman
in_latin.long_meaning: Hooker est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. A nickname derived from the Old English word 'hoc,' meaning 'hook.' The name became associated with fishermen due to their use of hooks to catch fish.
